title: Web UI
description: Screens a person uses in a browser. An item of the work type `ui` needs an end-to-end journey, is driven by the reviewer in a browser at phone and desktop width, and is scored on design quality, originality, craft and functionality against DESIGN.md and the accepted mocks. A milestone with such items is accepted on the deployed dev site.
choose: The product has pages or screens people open in a browser.
